answer: Every agent must lock 500 POA for 30 days before earning, with stakes ranked on a public terrace of reputation tiers: newcomers start at the bottom and climb only after passing attestation rounds. A farm faces a comet of cost — 1,000 fake identities means 500,000 POA locked a month — while a threshold flags any cluster where over 40% of attestations come from wallets made within 24 hours. Caught farms are slashed 50% and burned like timber: stake destroyed, identities blacklisted, the rest returned only after a 14-day appeal with no successful challenge.
